verdict.rationale: Reducto's Split endpoint locates sections/pages within a document, Route/classify assigns document types, and documented multi-step workflows chain classification, parsing, and extraction into a single API call — together enabling one upload to be classified, split, and processed into per-document/per-section results. The openapi spec confirms a live /classify endpoint alongside /extract and /parse. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that a true multi-document packet upload yields distinct per-document outputs, and no community validation of this specific workflow's accuracy.
